Bank Of Nova Scotia (BNS) Shares Declined While Burgundy Asset Management LTD Cut Its Holding; As Discover Financial Services (DFS) Stock Price Declined, Lvm Capital Management LTD Increased Position by $433,960
May 22, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy
Lvm Capital Management Ltd increased its stake in Discover Financial Services (DFS) by 6.44% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lvm Capital Management Ltd bought 5,710 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.95% with the market. The institutional investor held 94,437 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.26 million, up from 88,727 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lvm Capital Management Ltd who had been investing in Discover Financial Services for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $27.46 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.12% or $0.87 during the last trading session, reaching $78.7. About 531,187 shares traded. Discover Financial Services (NYSE:DFS) has risen 5.15% since May 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.40% the S&P500.
Burgundy Asset Management Ltd decreased its stake in Bank Of Nova Scotia (BNS) by 6.28% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Burgundy Asset Management Ltd sold 193,417 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.86% with the market. The institutional investor held 2.88M shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $186.54M, down from 3.08 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Burgundy Asset Management Ltd who had been investing in Bank Of Nova Scotia for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $75.36B market cap company. The stock increased 0.30% or $0.19 during the last trading session, reaching $62.84. About 214,296 shares traded. The Bank of Nova Scotia (NYSE:BNS) has risen 3.96% since May 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.59% the S&P500.
Lvm Capital Management Ltd, which manages about $495.24 million and $442.02 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) by 168,229 shares to 93,146 shares, valued at $3.37 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Stryker (NYSE:SYK) by 3,542 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 26,348 shares, and cut its stake in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL).
